title: Night Driver · Native Development
summary: Native source-derived speed, steering, road, distance and timer rules with the original character graphics, car, instructions and HUD. Development pacing, RGB palette, audio and attract behavior await original comparison.
notes: Native ARM64 development reconstruction; no source CPU executes. This is not a completed faithful rewrite.
Prepared original media are required. Run Tools/decode_night_driver.py after Tools/prepare_retro_media.py, then refresh the library. Original media stay local and are excluded from Git.
Native source/version-validated save/resume, pause and launch/return adapters. Behavior, visuals, audio, original modes and physical controller acceptance remain incomplete.
M5 Pro / 24 GB is development evidence only. Mandatory M1 Air / 8 GB sustained acceptance remains unverified.
keyboard: L / semicolon or Left / Right: steer
F1: keyboard / joystick; F3: paddle / trackpad
controller: Left stick / D-pad: steer; A: accelerate / start
Left stick: paddle in paddle mode
